$comment: Wisconsin board sizes: the single source for every venue canvas. Agents and tools: read llms.txt first; index.json is the flat, generated lookup.
Edit this file only, bump `version` (YYYY-MM-DD.N) and add a `changes` entry, then run `node scripts/build-board-sizes.mjs` to regenerate data.js, index.json, boards.csv and llms.txt.

venues/displays/zones are cross-referenced from four sources (see `sources`). Where they disagree or leave something open, the display or zone carries `issues` (kind: conflict, tbd, unconfirmed, naming) instead of a guess.

Sizes are width × height in px. Positions are {x, y} from the top-left of the display (x = left, y = top). A zone's `atFrom` says where its position came from: the sheet, the guide, the Board Builder, or `derived` from the sizes.

Every display and zone has a stable `id` (venue/display[/zone]); never rename one. `canvases` are the stable UPPER_SNAKE keys production tools build against (After Effects Board Builder, templates, audits); each points at a display, or a zone of one, and must match its size. `within: true` marks a region of a display that no source lists as a zone. `fps`/`duration` are the delivery spec where a source publishes one.

changes.summary: Adds draft `layouts` to the North Board, Kellner and Club Board: named sets of zone ids that fill the board together (for example Main + frames). Inferred from zone geometry and marked `draft: true` until confirmed. Sizes, ids and canvas keys are unchanged.

Agent-ready: stable ids on every display and zone, positions as {x, y}, open questions as typed `issues`, `notes` everywhere for plain information, `stillOnly` on zones to match canvases. Generated index.json, boards.csv and llms.txt. Canvas keys and every size are unchanged.
First published manifest: five venues cross-referenced from the Board Info sheet, the 2024 Camp Randall guide, Colosseum’s deliverables sheet and the Board Builder; 58 canvas keys.
